title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization
authors: J. Lin, J. Tang, H. Tang, et al. (10 authors)
before: 4-bit quantization decided which weights to protect using the weights themselves.
problem: Weight magnitude is the wrong signal; what matters is which weights see large activations.
breakthrough: Use activation statistics to choose the salient channels to preserve, with no backpropagation needed.
why: Better accuracy at 4-bit and faster kernels, and one of the two quantization formats local tooling offers.
next: Standard in vLLM and local inference alongside GPTQ and GGUF.
inherits: Activation-aware quantization in the serving stack.
